zh: 先确定选哪 K 个下标，再决定输出顺序，这两步可以分开做。
选择规则是值大的优先、值相同时下标小的优先，所以按“值降序、下标升序”排序后取前 K 个下标，恰好满足题目的截断规则。
对下标排序后取前 K 个，再把这 K 个下标按升序排列，依次输出对应元素，以空格分隔；K 为 0 时输出空行。
en: Decide which K indices to take first, then decide the output order; the two steps are independent.
Larger values win and, among equal values, smaller indices win, so sorting indices by value descending and index ascending and taking the first K matches the cutoff rule exactly.
Sort the indices that way and take the first K, then sort those K indices in ascending order and print the corresponding elements separated by spaces; print an empty line when K is 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Pick K indices by value in descending order and index in ascending order, then sort these indices in ascending order and output the corresponding elements.

## Correctness

The first sort strictly follows the rule of larger values first and, for equal values, earliest first, so the chosen set is correct; the second sort by original index only restores the original relative order and does not change which elements are chosen.

## Complexity

Time O(N log N), space O(N).
